C0336.title: Anti-Telecom Fraud Law Explicitly Bans Illegal Trading, Renting, and Lending of IoT SIMs
C0336.summary: The Anti-Telecommunications Network Fraud Law, passed on September 2, 2022, explicitly prohibits any entity or individual from illegally trading, renting, or lending phone cards and IoT cards, and from opening such cards or accounts under false identities or fabricated agency relationships.

references.title: Tougher penalties, real-name SIM card enforcement: What are the highlights of the new anti-telecom fraud law?
